description: This file is a shell script used as a test runner or automation script for repository setup, patch application, and workflow mirroring in a CI/CD environment. It contains functions to clone repositories, apply patches, and orchestrate the setup process for a testing environment related to the 'entservices-appgateway' project.

methods.name: ensure_repo_cloned
methods.description: Clones a git repository at a specific directory, checks out a specific ref, and updates it if it already exists.

methods.name: ensure_l1_workflow_repos_present
methods.description: Ensures that required repositories are cloned at specified locations for the CI workflow, using default or environment-specified refs.

methods.name: apply_patches_thundertools
methods.description: Applies specific patches to the ThunderTools repository as done in the CI process.

methods.name: apply_patches_thunder
methods.description: Applies a series of patches to the Thunder repository, mirroring CI steps.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for orchestrating repository setup and patch application steps for the test environment.
